reason: The person repeatedly sends the same status-line check ("N ticket changes since your last status line ... Check before stating anything ... Report only what you checked, each problem by ticket address#n"). It recurs many times per session and has no skill of its own. A fixed reporting procedure keeps each status report to checked facts.

The status line that woke the system agent with ticket counts was deleted (commit 758912ff). The skill's trigger describes a status-line check that no longer exists, so it now fires only when the person asks for a ticket status report. The checking rules stay.
